questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: She go to school every day.
She goes to school every day.
She going to school every day.
She gone to school every day.

questions.question: The present simple is often used for habits and routines.
La bonne réponse attendue est : do.
In English, adjectives are usually placed before the noun.
La bonne réponse attendue est : better.
Which sentence is correct?
choices: There is many students in class.
There are many students in class.
There are much students in class.
There is a many students in class.

questions.question: 'Much' is generally used with uncountable nouns.
